## 中文

这是测试用预发布版，不替代正式版 Latest。运行版本：`2026.10.29-operations.1`，联机协议：11。

- 改善移动端短按响应、操作席退出与断线回收、同步超时反馈；房间和席位入口保持可见，区分浏览器全屏与横屏布局。
- 新增可选 FPS/RTT 诊断面板、静态资源压缩与缓存、健康检查、访问统计和备份/恢复辅助工具。最近有效网络帧的年龄不是网络延迟。
- 本轮已通过核心 911,029 项检查、WASM/800 帧双端一致性、53 地图回放及联机/移动输入/席位/同步/运维专项回归；解压分享包的 WebSocket 回归已通过。发布流程另外校验文件 SHA-256、ZIP 完整性与打包内容。
- **限制：尚未完成真实手机/iPad 的触控与全屏验收；完整 Chromium 浏览器回归因运行环境限制未执行。全屏支持仍取决于设备和浏览器。** 不保证已解决所有移动端卡顿。

下载下方 Assets 中的 `Por2D-Web-Coop-Share.zip`，完整解压后按 `START-HERE.txt` 启动；不要把 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包当作玩家安装包。房主需要 Node.js 22 或更新版本，队友只需浏览器，无需 npm install。校验文件为同名 `.zip.sha256`。

## English

Testing prerelease; this does not replace the stable Latest release. Runtime: `2026.10.29-operations.1`; multiplayer protocol: 11.

- Improves mobile short taps, seat release/disconnection cleanup and bounded synchronization; keeps room/seat controls accessible and distinguishes browser fullscreen from landscape layout.
- Adds optional FPS/RTT diagnostics, compressed/cached assets, health checks, visit statistics and backup/restore helpers. Time since the last valid network frame is not network latency.
- Verified this round: 911,029 native core checks, WASM/800-frame two-client consistency, 53-map replay coverage and focused multiplayer/mobile-input/seat/sync/operations regressions, including an extracted-bundle WebSocket test. The release job also verifies SHA-256, ZIP integrity and packaged bytes.
- **Limitations: real phone/iPad touch and fullscreen acceptance is pending; the full Chromium browser suite was not run due to environment restrictions. Fullscreen remains browser/device dependent.** This is not a claim that all mobile lag is resolved.

Download `Por2D-Web-Coop-Share.zip` from Assets, extract fully and follow `START-HERE.txt`. GitHub's autogenerated Source code archives are not the player package. Hosts need Node.js 22 or newer; other players only need a browser. No npm install required. The adjacent `.zip.sha256` file contains the archive checksum.
